Name: (Content Patcher) Vanilla Female Bachelors Patch for Spouse and Roommate Buffs
Author: brifoundthebingus
Description:
[b]This patch is for AirynS's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17792]Spouse and Roommate Buffs[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url].
[/b]
[size=2][i]Requested by a user of both mods. Permission was granted from Airyn to upload this patch and he is aware of the manner in which it was written. The edited buff descriptions are all his original writing except for the name of the NPC the buff is given by, which has been changed, however Airyn himself does not provide any support for Invatorzen's mod. Please keep issues with this patch here and do not go to either parent mod's page for help with this patch. Thank you![/i][/size]

This patch edits several of Airyn's buffs' descriptions to match the names changed by Invatorzen's mod, and applies an overlay of new buff icons to the asset loaded by Airyn's mod. 3 descriptions have been changed, and buff icons for all bachelors have been changed.

This patch is a Content Patcher mod, not a drop-and-replace of loose files. To install, add the contained folder to your mods folder. It requires the parent mods to be present and in fact would not apply any buffs without Airyn's mod anyway, as his mod contains the triggers for the buffs.

Thank you to the user behind DummyAccount03 for making the edited buff icons and sending them to me, as well as diligently testing earlier versions of the patch before I transitioned to having my sister help out for the sake of seeing issues in realtime. Big thanks to Airyn for giving me permission to upload this patch containing a couple edited lines of his writing, and for offering advice on how to simplify the edits I made when I forgot that TargetField existed.
